The helper checks common options, short task copies, all original parent25 metadata and output mapping before native batch. The API and solver aliases actually used are observed once; original arguments and return objects are forwarded. The previous on_accept callback is forwarded, and both aliases are restored in finally.

on_accept writes chronological scalar/stateSHA progress only. The observer stores scalar cached gates, actual settings and original call-count metadata per case, with no result/matrix object retained globally and no forced garbage collection. Snapshot J/fixed split fsum and all original gate expressions match the pilot AST exactly.

The original API persists result and response before the outer observed evaluate checks success-only cache gates. A failed/error original response is forwarded unchanged; success with false cache gates raises original TMCError/ValueError handling into batch, preserving original saved result/response bytes. The batch stops later cases and retains not_run states.

No display is reached unless batch/all case status and original cache gates pass. Actual accepted N may exceed three through existing bisection; all actual rows, repeated target identities and all archived states remain in the original result and viewer.

The clean viewer child uses the unchanged original source and six-file pure closure, receives both manifest-ordered cases at once, uses no reference argument, and retains three shared PNGs/two actual-N-frame GIFs. Parent display does not import production code into the viewer, decode media, read matrices or recompute F/T.

The labelled convergence observer is inverse-AST identical to its frozen source after undoing only module docstring, label/title keyword parameters/title assignment, schema/provenance metadata and returned label. All projection fields, raw history/trial/failed records, grouping, tolerances/units and zero-preserving symlog plotting remain unchanged.

Display consumes the actual native response/result/model/state descriptor schema, checks SHA linkage, original cached body-resultant identity through the original pure viewer, and binds actual archives. It writes a manifest-ordered original-value state table/manual page and optionally places old first-three-target JSON scalars alongside new values without ratios, new error gates, rankings or qualification transfer.

The inherited viewer alone performs saved-array geometry/nodal/Green-strain observations and actual media frame checks; zero-mechanics scope is from its pinned pure module origins, not universal dynamic mechanical hooks. Neither views nor wrappers upgrade raw producer flags or independent reference qualification.

The resource clock starts before heavy helper imports. Each original controller receives1800s. One shared display deadline is min(display start+600s, explicit remaining helper monotonic deadline), applies to viewer polling, both convergence callbacks, page/table and all display-product streamed SHA/size. Display seal includes complete view and convergence trees, view_protocol, table/page and viewer log; every1MiB read uses the shared check. This closes the author-stage budget-role gap without changing graphics, mechanics, gates or resource totals.

Passing requires its normal exit0, exact supervisor SHA, F-CPU-CLEAN1/CPU-CLEAN1 and same-instance cleanup_verified plus helper pass/complete seal. Packaging only stages ordinary source/task/protocol/auth records, asserts clean baseline/new stage, and records the two old geometry NPZ pins plus stat sizes without reading payload. The launcher hashes ordinary source bindings only; old geometry NPZ inputs belong solely to the future authorized helper window.
